gloss: to see through to the end; to finish completely

definitions.gloss: to see through to the end; to carry out fully; to finish completely
definitions.explanation: To do something all the way to completion without giving up partway, often with the sense of having put everything into it. Common in talk about work, training, and personal goals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧やり{切|き}った。
examples.english: I saw it through to the end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧こと⟦はやり→はやり：28223_hayari⟧⟦{切|き}りたい→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I want to carry through whatever I have decided to do.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧やり{切|き}ること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It was a difficult job, but the whole team managed to see it through.

notes:
Formed from ⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (to do) plus the auxiliary ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧, which adds the sense of doing something completely or to the limit — as in ⟦{使|つか}い{切|き}る→使い切る：11518_tsukaikiru⟧ (to use up) and ⟦{出|だ}し{切|き}る→出し切る：30155_dashikiru⟧ (to give everything one has).

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive; the thing completed is marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, though it is often left unstated when clear from context (⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧やり{切|き}る).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧やり{切|き}る: to see it through to the very end
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やり{切|き}る: to follow through on one's own decisions
- やり{切|き}る⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧: the ability to follow through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やり{遂|と}げる→やり遂げる：16745_yaritogeru⟧: to accomplish — more formal and literary, stressing achievement of a goal
- ⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to get done — neutral about effort; simply finishing a task
